rows.text: A hash map uses chaining or open addressing to handle collisions. Chaining stores collided items in a linked list at the same index. Open addressing finds another open slot nearby. Both methods ensure all data is stored efficiently.

A robot found a paintbrush. It dipped it in paint and made a mark. The robot tried again. Soon it was painting pictures. It learned to make art. The robot was happy. It kept painting. It never stopped learning. It painted all day. It painted all night. It painted forever.
